items.sentence: A map shows traffic reaching markets along connected roads.
Today, the major road leads straight to the busy harbor.
The route shortens travel distance between farms and markets.
While carrying the tall stack of plates, do not rush.
One small yellow vehicle delivered bread to the village.
Boats transport fruit farther where rivers connect distant towns.
Today, farmers utilize rainwater to keep the vegetables green.
One remote cabin stood alone among the snowy pines.
Today, frogs leap easily from one lily pad to another.
Today, the old bucket started to leak water onto the ground.
